newsitem.title: SPAIN: Cuba confirms blackballing of new Spanish envoy.
newsitem.headline: Cuba confirms blackballing of new Spanish envoy.

text.p: Cuba woke up the Spanish ambassador to Havana on Tuesday to tell him it was withdrawing the credentials of his successor, Spain's foreign ministry said.
"They got our (current) ambassador out of bed before dawn," a ministry official told Reuters.
It was the first official confirmation of the move by Havana, which follows weeks of rising tension over the new conservative Spanish government's hard line against Cuban leader Fidel Castro.

The official, who asked not to be named, said the withdrawal by Havana of its earlier acceptance of a new Spanish envoy, due to go to Havana in early December, was the strongest protest possible short of breaking relations.
Foreign Minister Abel Matutes called a news conference for 1.15 p.m. (1215 GMT) and diplomatic sources said the Cuban ambassador to Madrid was likely to be called in for a protest.
